description: Intent i011 (net-epidx, snapshot s03) complete. Two high-confidence variants of the seed mechanism found in USB networking drivers of snapshots/s03: (1) drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c:3762-3772 — lan78xx_probe assigns dev->ep_blkin/ep_blkout/ep_intr = (intf->cur_altsetting)->endpoint + 0/1/2 at fixed indexes with no bNumEndpoints validation anywhere in the probe path (the driver's only bNumEndpoints use is the loop bound in lan78xx_get_endpoints at line 2879), then immediately dereferences endpoint+2's desc.bEndpointAddress to program dev->pipe_intr via usb_rcvintpipe and reads bInterval and wMaxPacketSize (usb_maxpacket) to size the interrupt URB buffer — plug-in triggered OOB read / NULL-deref identical in class to the seed cx231xx bug; (2) drivers/net/usb/qmi_wwan.c:672-687 — qmi_wwan_register_subdriver unconditionally takes info->control->cur_altsetting->endpoint[0] as dev->status whenever a CDC Union names a separate data interface, without any bNumEndpoints > 0 check on the control altsetting, and passes &dev->status->desc to usb_cdc_wdm_register/wdm_create, which only type-checks usb_endpoint_is_int_in(ep) and then uses usb_endpoint_maxp(ep) to size the WDM interrupt buffer and ep->bEndpointAddress/bInterval to program the URB — a gadget with a 0-endpoint control interface makes endpoint[0] read beyond the flex array. Evidence-backed negatives recorded for the rest of the branch: cdc-phonet (validates bNumEndpoints==2 before endpoint[0]/[1]), cdc_ether (bNumEndpoints==1 check before endpoint[0]), r8152 (bNumEndpoints<3 rejected at probe before endpoint+2), sierra_net (numendpoints!=3 rejected), hso, usbnet_get_endpoints, cdc_ncm, ipheth (all loop-bounded), and the entire drivers/net/wireless tree (ath10k, ath6kl, ath9k, carl9170, p54usb, orinoco, mwifiex, libertas, libertas_tf, rtlwifi, rtl8xxxu, rsi, mt76, mt7601u, zd1211rw, at76c50x, rt2x00 — every endpoint[] access is loop-bounded by bNumEndpoints; no fixed-index read found). drivers/net/wwan is absent in s03. Limitations: findings are structural hypotheses without live-gadget proof; tree has no version metadata; can-usb endpoints were only grep-observed (out of branch scope); interface-count gaps deferred to if-alt-count branch i013. Final artifact written and quote-validated at agent-state/findings/i011.json with snapshots_checked=["s03"].
